top_categories.workout_context: 538 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.
Race-pace efforts that mimic SBS Bank Tour of Southland's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before January.

Road-specific control matters at SBS Bank Tour of Southland. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 538 miles.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
538 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what SBS Bank Tour of Southland's mixed terrain actually does to you.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 538 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
SBS Bank Tour of Southland's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at SBS Bank Tour of Southland. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
At SBS Bank Tour of Southland, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of SBS Bank Tour of Southland. Train it until it feels boring.

race_overlay.nutrition: For a multi-day 538-mile race, no single calorie total or one-food strategy is credible. Rehearse continuous intake while riding plus substantial meals at planned stops; document carbohydrate, fluid, and sodium intake, resupply cadence, and gut response. Use checkpoints and publicly available services only as the category rules allow, carry backup calories, and complete a full night-riding systems rehearsal.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at SBS Bank Tour of Southland rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Race Simulation, and Road Specific to prepare you for 538 miles of mixed terrain in Invercargill, Southland, New Zealand.
